comment: Partner offer registry. DATA ONLY - update offers and payouts here without touching calculator code. A partner renders ONLY when active is true AND url is a real https referral link. The fuel-savings line renders ONLY when an ACTIVE eligible fuel-card partner carries its own discount_range: { low, high, unit: 'usd_per_gallon', source: '<direct https URL to the partner's advertised terms>', verified_date: 'YYYY-MM-DD' } - taken from that partner's WRITTEN terms, never a generic industry range. No qualifying partner means no savings claim on the page. payout_* fields are informational metadata, never shown as promises. Categories: factoring | fuel-card | insurance | eld | tax.
